outcome: number of unscheduled maternal or child visits and their indications
cohort: The study included 12,245 women who delivered after 22 weeks gestation in 2022.
finding: Healthcare utilization postpartum was mainly for minor complaints, with unscheduled visits occurring in 44% of the cohort predominantly for infections, and women with caesarean section or preterm delivery required additional support.
mod_finding: Wound infection was more common with instrumental delivery, musculoskeletal pain (especially back pain) was more common after caesarean delivery, and women delivering by caesarean section needed additional postpartum support.
